item.title: Implement Claude Landing Page Design
item.description:
30-250 USD | I already have a complete visual blueprint for a business landing page—the mock-ups, spacing specs, and type scales were prepared by Claude. What I now need is the hands-on build: a developer-designer who can translate those files into a fully responsive page that renders perfectly on desktop and mobile.
The essentials you must replicate are: • the exact layout hierarchy and section flow • the colour palette and font pairings defined by Claude and reinforced in my brand guide
Images and iconography can remain as temporary placeholders; I’ll swap in final assets later. Consistency with my existing brand guide is non-negotiable, so all colours, typography sizes, and button states have to match both the mock-up and the guide.
Please deliver clean, well-commented HTML, CSS (or SCSS), and any lightweight JavaScript needed for interactive elements. Build tools such as Figma to code, Tailwind, or plain CSS are all acceptable—choose whichever lets you hit pixel-perfect accuracy quickest. The finished files should be ready for me to drop into a standard hosting environment.
If this sounds straightforward to you, let me know your timeline and a quick note on how you ensure fidelity between design and code.

item.title: Complete Website Design & Development for Premium Australian Outdoor Living Brand – POD KING -- 2
item.description: 750-4000 AUD | We are looking for an experienced website designer/developer or small web design team to design and build a complete new website for POD KING, an Australian premium outdoor-living and modular product brand. Our three main product categories are: - Premium Outdoor Kitchen Pods - Modular Outdoor Kitchens & BBQs - Modular & Foldable Housing Options We already have our brand, logo, product concepts, product imagery and a clear direction for the business. We now need someone to bring everything together into a professional, high-end website ready for launch in the Australian market. Our products are higher-value purchases, so the website will initially focus primarily on showcasing our products, building trust in the POD KING brand and generating qualified customer enquiries, rather than being a traditional e-commerce store. IMPORTANT – Homepage Live Within 5 Days We want to move quickly. Our first priority is to have a professionally designed, fully functional and launch-ready homepage live within approximately 5 days of commencing the project. The homepage needs to establish the overall POD KING brand and clearly introduce our three main product categories: Outdoor Kitchen Pods | Modular Outdoor Kitchens & BBQs | Housing Options It should include strong product imagery, key brand messaging, calls to action, enquiry functionality and full mobile responsiveness. Once the homepage is approved and launched, development of the remaining website can continue immediately afterward. Please only apply if you have the availability to begin promptly and can realistically deliver a high-quality homepage within this timeframe. Initial Website Scope For the initial launch, we expect approximately 6–10 main pages, likely including: - Home - Outdoor Kitchen Pods - Modular Outdoor Kitchens & BBQs - Modular & Foldable Housing - How It Works / Customisation - About POD KING - Gallery - FAQ - Contact / Get a Quote Individual product/model pages may also sit underneath the main product categories. The exact sitemap can be finalized with the successful freelancer. The website will continue to grow as we introduce additional products and models. Website Style & Design The website needs to look and feel premium, modern, clean and high-end. We want a design similar in quality and presentation to a premium architectural, luxury outdoor-living, high-end kitchen or home-improvement brand. The website must be designed specifically for Australian customers. We do not want a generic WordPress/template website with our logo and photographs simply dropped into it. We are looking for someone with strong UI/UX and graphic design skills who can develop a distinctive visual identity for POD KING online. The website should be highly visual, with: - Large premium product imagery - Clean modern typography - Simple navigation - Strong product presentation - Premium page layouts - Excellent mobile presentation - Clear calls to action throughout the website The overall impression should be that POD KING is an established, premium Australian brand. Product Presentation The website will initially focus on three main POD KING product categories. 1. Outdoor Kitchen Pods Premium self-contained outdoor kitchen and entertainment pods designed for Australian backyards and outdoor living. These products may include premium BBQs, rangehoods, refrigeration, sinks, storage, TVs, audio, lighting and other integrated appliances and features. 2. Modular Outdoor Kitchens & BBQs Premium modular outdoor kitchen systems, BBQs, cabinetry, appliances and customizable configurations that customers can tailor to suit their outdoor space. Customers should be able to clearly understand the available layouts, options, finishes and configurations. 3. Modular & Foldable Housing Innovative modular and foldable housing solutions with different layouts, sizes, finishes and configurations available. These will form an important additional product category within the POD KING brand. The website needs to make it easy for customers to understand the differences between these three categories while maintaining a consistent premium POD KING brand identity. Product pages should showcase: - High-quality imagery - Product features - Specifications - Dimensions - Available configurations - Colors and finishes - Appliances/options where applicable - Galleries/video - Downloadable information where appropriate - Strong enquiry and quote calls to action Some products may display "Starting from $XX,XXX + delivery", while others will be enquiry-only. Website Functionality The website should include: - Fully responsive desktop, tablet and mobile design - Fast loading and strong technical performance - Professional enquiry and quote forms - Get a Quote / Enquire Now / Secure Your Install calls to action - Product image galleries - Video capability - Product specifications and features - Downloadable brochures/specification sheets - Customer lead capture - Social-media integration - Google Analytics/tracking setup - Meta Pixel capability - Basic on-page SEO - SEO-friendly page structure and URLs - Google Search Console setup - Easy-to-use CMS - SSL/security - Anti-spam protection - Reliable delivery of enquiries to our Australian business email The website should also be structured so that additional products, pages and categories can easily be added in the future. Content We Can Supply POD KING can provide: - Logo and branding - Product photos and renders - Product specifications - Product and factory videos - Existing advertising graphics - Product information - Business information We would also like the successful freelancer to assist with: - Page structure and layout - UI/UX - Image selection - Image optimization - Website presentation - Professional English website copy - Calls to action and customer enquiry flow We are happy to work closely with the successful freelancer and provide additional information throughout the project. Website Platform We are open to recommendations regarding WordPress, Webflow or another suitable mainstream CMS. Please explain which platform you recommend for POD KING and why. We want a website that is easy to manage, scalable and capable of growing with the business. Ownership – Important The finished website and associated digital assets must be 100% owned and controlled by POD KING. This includes, where applicable: - Website files - Source code - Design/source files - Domain - Hosting account - CMS administrator access - Google Analytics - Google Search Console - Advertising/tracking accounts - Graphics and website assets - Any custom code developed for the project We do not want to be locked into a proprietary system that can only be controlled by the developer. Who We're Looking For We would prefer an experienced individual or small, capable web design team rather than a large expensive agency. The successful applicant should: - Have excellent UI/UX and graphic design skills - Be capable of creating a genuinely premium website - Have experience with premium product, home or lifestyle brands - Understand Western/Australian website design - Communicate clearly in English - Be available to begin promptly - Be capable of delivering the initial homepage within approximately 5 days - Offer competitive international pricing - Be interested in a longer-term relationship - Be available for future website updates and development Experience with outdoor living, kitchens, BBQs, architecture, construction, modular homes, furniture or other premium physical products would be particularly valuable. When Applying – Please Read Carefully Please do not send us a generic copy-and-paste proposal. Start your proposal with the words: POD KING This will confirm that you have read the complete project brief. Please provide: 1. 3–5 examples of your best and most relevant websites. 2. Explain which parts of those websites you personally designed/developed. 3. Your recommended website platform for POD KING and why. 4. Your fixed price for the complete initial 6–10 page website. 5. Confirmation that you can deliver a professional, launch-ready homepage within approximately 5 days. 6. Your estimated timeframe for completing the remainder of the website. 7. Number of revisions included. 8. A clear explanation of what is and isn't included in your price. 9. Whether professional English copywriting is included. 10. Whether basic SEO, Google Analytics and tracking setup are included. 11. Your ongoing website support/maintenance costs after launch. Budget We are looking for quality and value rather than simply choosing the lowest bid. We prefer a fixed project price rather than only an hourly rate. There is significant potential for ongoing work with POD KING after the initial website is completed, including new product pages, landing pages, website updates, product launches, advertising material and potentially social-media content. We are looking to establish a long-term working relationship with the right designer/developer or team.

item.title: Streamline Website Layout & Content
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | My website has drifted into disarray and I’d like a fresh pair of eyes—and hands—to bring it back into shape. The two areas that need attention are the overall design layout and several pieces of outdated content.
Layout-wise, the chief issue is a cluttered interface. Pages feel cramped, elements compete for attention, and the spacing is uneven. I want a cleaner visual hierarchy with sensible white space and clear organization so visitors can find what they need without digging.
Content-wise, some copy and graphics no longer reflect our current offerings. I will supply updated text and any new images you need; your task is to replace or archive the old material and make sure each page reads smoothly once the design changes are in place.
Deliverables: • Reworked page layouts that showcase improved spacing and logical grouping of elements • Removal or replacement of all outdated copy, images, and links provided by me • Cross-browser / mobile checks to confirm the refreshed pages render consistently • A concise change log summarizing what was updated and where
If you’re comfortable taking a mildly chaotic site and turning it into a tidy, current, and user-friendly experience, I’d love to hear how you’d approach it and see a timeline for completion.

item.title: Multi-Company Project Management System
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need a web-based platform that can oversee projects coming from several related companies from a single dashboard. The core focus is employee assignment and tracking: each incoming project should let a manager review available staff and manually assign the right people to every task while the system records hours and shows live progress.
Beyond assignment, I still want the usual workflow tools—task creation, due dates, file attachments, comments—so our teams always have context. Every project also carries billing details. The system must generate invoices, record when they are sent, and allow us to mark payments as received or outstanding, then surface quick reports on what is still unpaid.
Because multiple companies and departments will use the tool, role-based access control is essential. Administrators manage companies and users, managers handle task assignment and billing, and employees see only their own work and timesheets.
Tech stack is open—Laravel, Django, Node, or even a solid low-code foundation—as long as the code is clean, well-documented, and easy to extend.
Acceptance criteria: • Separate spaces for multiple companies, each with isolated data. • Manual assignment interface that filters staff by skill or availability. • Real-time dashboards for projects and individual workloads. • Invoice generator with payment status tracking and summary reports. • Robust role permissions: Admin, Manager, Employee. • Responsive UI, source code in a private repo, and clear deployment steps.

item.title: Clinic Digital Lead Generation Campaign
item.description:
30-250 USD | I run a medical clinic and I’m ready to ramp up our online presence with one clear objective: bring in qualified patient leads. TikTok will be the hero channel, and I’d like to centre the content there around short, engaging educational videos that explain our treatments, answer common questions, and remove patient anxiety.
Alongside TikTok, I still want a coordinated push across Instagram, Snapchat, Twitter, Google Search, and our existing WordPress website so that every touchpoint drives people to book a consultation. Consistent messaging, tight targeting, and measurable conversions are key.
What I need from you • A performance-focused TikTok content calendar (educational, 15-60 sec formats) plus full scripting, filming guidance, and posting schedule. • Paid media setup and optimisation in TikTok Ads Manager, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, and Snapchat Ads—complete with audience research, ad copy, creative direction, and A/B tests. • Conversion-optimised landing pages (or improvements to our current site) with tracking pixels, event tags, and clear calls to action. • Weekly reporting that ties spend to booked appointments so we can see cost per lead in real time.
Acceptance criteria 1. Lead capture forms and phone-call tracking fire correctly in Google Analytics 4. 2. At least three educational TikTok videos go live each week for the first month. 3. Paid campaigns achieve a cost per lead that meets or beats our historical average by week four.
If you’ve previously turned social traffic into patient bookings, I’d love to see examples and hear how you’d approach the first 90 days.

item.title: Swedish Real Estate Website Build
item.description:
250-750 USD | I have already uploaded the complete design and page-by-page layout for a modern, Swedish-style real-estate management site. Your task is to turn those files into a fully working, responsive website that exactly matches the look and feel supplied.
Core scope • Implement every screen in the design, keeping typography, spacing, and color usage pixel-accurate. • Set up a straightforward property-listing structure so I can add, edit, and archive listings without touching code. A lightweight CMS, headless solution, or a custom admin panel is fine—choose whichever lets future staff manage content with minimal training. • Add a clear, GDPR-compliant contact form on both the main “Contact” page and each property detail page. Submissions should arrive in our company mailbox with the property reference automatically included when relevant. No other third-party integrations are needed right now.
Technical notes • Mobile-first, fully responsive, tested on the latest Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge. • Optimise images and code for fast loading; Lighthouse score above 90 for performance and accessibility. • Clean, well-commented code or a documented theme structure so any in-house developer can continue work later.
Deliverables 1. Deployed website on our hosting (credentials will be supplied). 2. Source code / theme package in a zipped folder. 3. Short hand-off guide covering how to add new properties and where the contact-form emails are routed.
I’m happy to answer design questions quickly as you work; just reference the page name and layer from the uploaded file when you do.

item.title: Update WordPress E-commerce Theme
item.description:
30-250 AUD | I need my WooCommerce site’s theme brought up to its latest stable version without interrupting sales. The live payment gateways must keep working throughout the process and be retested before we switch the new files to production.
We’ll review any custom CSS, layout tweaks, or plug-in hooks together so they survive the upgrade intact. Please outline the approach you usually follow—staging, testing, and go-live—plus how long each step tends to take and the level of post-update support you include.
Deliverables 1. Current site fully backed up and a rollback point created. 2. Theme and child theme updated on a staging copy, with payment gateways verified. 3. Zero-downtime deployment to production and final round of testing.
Hands-on experience with WordPress core updates, WooCommerce, and safe deployment practices (Git/SFTP, WP-CLI, or similar) will be a big plus.

item.title: Revival Cigar Company - Shopify Cigar Store Setup
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | I already have a Shopify account and a couple of premium cigars ready to list—I now need someone to transform that blank canvas into a modern, clean online store that works flawlessly from the first click to the final payment.
Here’s what I’m aiming for: • A sleek, uncluttered design that matches a modern and clean aesthetic, with typography and color choices that feel high-end yet welcoming to cigar aficionados. • Proper product pages for our initial one-to-two SKUs, including concise, engaging descriptions, high-quality images, and the correct variant options so customers immediately see vitals such as ring gauge and wrapper type. • A streamlined checkout flow with secure payment gateways configured, tax and shipping rules set, and test orders run so we know everything fires correctly before launch. • A built-in customer reviews section to build credibility from day one. • Seamless social media integration (Instagram and Facebook at minimum) so new posts and promotions can drive traffic directly to the product pages.
Once complete, I should be able to add new cigars or limited editions myself without breaking the layout, so please document any custom sections or settings you create. Let’s keep the site lightweight, compliant with Shopify’s latest theme standards, and mobile-optimized so cigar lovers on any device can browse, add to cart, and check out without friction.

item.title: Upload ABB & Wix Redirects
item.description:
30-250 AUD | The project scope has been fully expanded to include the layout updates for your two existing live applications. The master Project Proposal & Scope of Work (SOW) now spans a grand total of five (5) featured image listings alongside your master developer banner profile setup and the four (4) Wix routing engines. You can copy and paste this complete, finalized contract document straight into your [Freelancer.com](https://www.freelancer.com/) project panel. ------------------------------ ## Project Proposal & Scope of Work (SOW)## 1. Project Summary Deployment of three (3) brand-new production Android application bundles (.aab files) to the client's Google Play Console, simultaneous storefront visual asset updates for two (2) existing live applications, master developer profile banner optimization, and custom programmatic front-end updates using Wix Velo to handle conditional role-based redirects for four (4) distinct membership tiers. ------------------------------ ## 2. Detailed Task Breakdown & Deliverables## Task 1: Google Play Console Deployment & Storefront Updates (5 Apps Total + Profile Header)
* Developer Profile Header Banner Update: Update the master Developer Page Profile Header banner graphic using the provided custom 4096 × 2304 pixel image (Opaque/Solid Background). Ensure text safe-zones render correctly without breaking layouts on both mobile and desktop viewports. * Storefront Image Updates for Existing Apps (2 Apps): * Access the storefront listings for the two (2) applications currently live on the Google Play Store. * Remove the legacy background graphics and upload the updated custom 1024 × 500 pixel Feature Graphics provided by the client. * New App Asset Upload & Configuration (3 New Apps): Set up, configure, and launch the store listing layouts using the provided production .aab bundles generated via WebToAPK. * Compliance Setup: Link the official corporate privacy policy page: gritz.id. * Mandatory Review Provision: Input active tester user credentials inside the "App Access" portal fields so Google's manual testing engineers can bypass the login walls to review page functionality. * Listing Graphics Management (Per New App Verification): * New App 1 (Gritz Grosir): Upload the 512x512 App Icon (with alpha transparency), the 1024x500 Feature Graphic, and a minimum of 2 to 8 mandatory 16:9/9:16 portrait phone screenshots. Tablet assets are completely excluded. * New App 2 (Gritz Production): Upload the 512x512 App Icon (with alpha transparency), the 1024x500 Feature Graphic, and a minimum of 2 to 8 mandatory 16:9/9:16 portrait phone screenshots. Tablet assets are completely excluded. * New App 3 (Gritz Food Delivery): Upload the 512x512 App Icon (with alpha transparency), the 1024x500 Feature Graphic, a minimum of 2 to 8 portrait phone screenshots, 2 to 8 landscape 7-inch tablet screenshots (1920x1200 pixels), and 2 to 8 landscape 10-inch tablet screenshots (1920x1200 pixels) to optimize algorithmic search indexes and tablet store formatting views. * Metadata & Store Descriptions: Copy, paste, and publish the specific mixed-language text strings detailed below:
## App 1: Gritz Grosir
* App Title: Gritz Grosir * Short Description: Online ordering application for hotels and restaurant supplies. * Full Description: Gritz Grosir is an online ordering application for Hotels. Perlengkapan hotel, makanan & perlengkapan restoran, produk kebersihan, dan banyak lagi—semuanya dari satu aplikasi
## App 2: Gritz Production
* App Title: Gritz Production * Short Description: Online ordering supply application for Gritz Restaurants and kitchens. * Full Description: Gritz Production is an online ordering application for Gritz Restaurants. Pesan makanan, minuman, kemasan, serta perlengkapan dapur dan kebersihan—semuanya dalam satu aplikasi.
## App 3: Gritz Food Delivery

## Google Play Data Safety Declaration Profile (Applies to all 3 new builds):
* Nature of the Application: Native web-wrapper framing a secure online website portal supporting standard Google OAuth social logins. * Financial Details / In-App Payments: NO. The application features no integrated checkout engines, in-app purchases, or credit card collection forms. * Permissions Profile: NO phone camera usage, NO media storage permissions requested, and NO foreground/background GPS tracking mechanisms utilized inside these specific wrapper configurations. * User Account Security: Collects only fundamental account credentials (Username/Password/Email) strictly for system authentication. All data traffic is securely encrypted in transit.
------------------------------ ## Task 2: Wix Velo Redirection Debugging & Multi-Role Expansion
* Role 1 Code Audit & Fix (Automated Sign-up Tier): * Debug the pre-existing logic string tracking the case-sensitive dashboard role Menyewa Dan Mengoperasikan. * Troubleshoot why this conditional loop currently fails to route users upon sign-up or landing. * Correct the code path to firmly execute a redirect to the target URL layout: https://gritz.id * Role 2 Code Expansion (Manual Service Staff Tier): * Program a new intercept statement inside the primary routing array to isolate users assigned the role Service Staff. * Force an instant transition to the specialized team dashboard upon portal entry: https://gritz.id * Role 3 Code Expansion (Manual Production Staff Tier): * Program an intercept statement inside the routing array to isolate users assigned the role Production Staff. * Force an instant transition to the specialized production dashboard upon portal entry: https://gritz.id * Role 4 Code Expansion (Manual Delivery Staff Tier): * Program an intercept statement inside the routing array to isolate users assigned the role Delivery Staff. * Force an instant transition to the specialized delivery dashboard upon portal entry: https://gritz.id * Web-Wrapper Execution Check: Ensure all Velo location statements (wixLocation.to) evaluate smoothly within a standard mobile web-wrapper environment (WebToAPK), implementing necessary viewport exceptions if required to completely prevent infinite page reload loops.
------------------------------ ## 3. Project Milestones & Release Conditions
* Milestone 1 ($60.00 USD) — Wix Logic Completion: Released once all four (4) routing blocks are operational across desktop and mobile layouts, ensuring the existing bug is resolved and the three new roles map cleanly to their respective destination URLs. * Milestone 2 ($60.00 USD) — Google Play Store Submission: Released the moment all three (3) independent application packages clear pre-upload processing errors inside the console dashboard, the master profile header updates cleanly, both live apps display their new feature graphics, and all tracks transition into the official "Under Review" standing within production tracks.
------------------------------ Whenever your developer accepts the project and completes the code deployment tracks, let me know if you would like me to output the Wix Redirect Verification Script to test that the authentication logic loops are running correctly!

item.title: Create Professional Mobile Welding Website
item.description:
30-250 CAD | I run Spark Metal Works Ltd., a mobile welding and metal-repair service that brings the shop to farms, job sites, and residential properties across Alberta. To present our brand online, I need a polished, professional, and clean website that instantly communicates convenience, reliability, and skill.
Design & structure • Visual tone: professional and clean—think crisp typography, balanced white space, and strong imagery of on-site welding work. • Core pages: Home, About Us, and Services. I will supply copy points and photos; you refine layout, flow, and calls-to-action. • Responsive layout: must look and work flawlessly on phones, tablets, and desktops.
Key functionalities • Contact form routed to my business email, with spam protection and clear confirmation messaging. • Online booking system so customers can choose a service type, select preferred dates, and submit job details; simple back-end interface for me to confirm or reschedule requests. • Photo gallery showcasing trailer repairs, farm equipment fixes, and custom fabrications, organised by category and easy for me to update.
Technical preferences • Built on WordPress, Webflow, or another mainstream CMS that lets me edit text, swap photos, and add new projects without coding. • Fast load times, basic SEO best practices, and Google Analytics integration ready to activate. • Hosting and domain are already in place; migration assistance appreciated.
Deliverables 1. Fully responsive website with the three pages and listed features, ready to go live. 2. Admin credentials plus a brief video or PDF guide showing how to add new photos and manage bookings. 3. Two rounds of post-launch tweaks for polish and bug fixes.
If you have recent examples of service-based websites—especially trade or field-service industries—please share them so I can see your style. I’m aiming to award quickly and move straight into design.

item.title: Consulting Service Website Development
item.description:
250-750 AUD | My psychology practice, **Psyche Clinical Psychology**, needs a clean, sophisticated and service-oriented website that clearly communicates who I am, the psychological services I provide, and my approach to therapy. The primary purpose is to establish a professional online presence and encourage prospective clients to enquire, rather than e-commerce or direct public booking.
I want a contemporary, premium and mobile-responsive design that feels **warm, calm, trustworthy and clinically professional**, rather than overly corporate or medical. The branding is centred around deep navy, gold and light neutral tones, with an elegant, minimal aesthetic. I already have my logo, branding direction and most website copy prepared.
Core pages will include **Home, About, Individual Therapy, REGULATE (my DBT group program), Fees & FAQs, and Contact**. Individual Therapy should direct prospective clients to an enquiry form rather than displaying my booking calendar publicly. Clear navigation, tasteful calls-to-action, fast performance and basic on-page SEO are essential.
**Deliverables** • Fully responsive multi-page website built on WordPress, Webflow or another mainstream CMS that allows me to edit content myself • Professional implementation of my existing branding, copy and photography • Individual Therapy, REGULATE and general enquiry/contact forms with spam protection • Clean, fast and mobile-friendly design • Search-engine-friendly structure with basic SEO, page titles, meta descriptions and image alt tags • Integration capability with my practice-management/booking system where required • Full website ownership and handover, including instructions on how to update content
The finished website should feel **high-end, elegant and distinctive while remaining appropriate for an Australian clinical psychology practice**. It should also be easy to expand as the practice and REGULATE program grow.
Please share the platform you would recommend, what is included in your quote, expected timeframe, and links to 2–3 professional service, healthcare, psychology or similarly premium websites you have designed.

item.title: Integrated Car Auction Website & Marketing for the Car broker and dealership
item.description:
30-250 USD | The project combines a subscription-based car auction platform with an always-on marketing engine.
Website scope • Feed integration from several auction sources so members can view inventory in real time. • Live bidding functionality and detailed car pages are non-negotiable; the flow must feel as seamless as the original auction sites. • A gated paywall: visitors browse freely, but bidding and “buy now” unlock once they purchase a subscription. • A dedicated Marketing and promotional content section where fresh videos, posts and offers keep buyers engaged and improve SEO.
Marketing deliverables I will need ongoing content for the dealership—short videos of new arrivals, written posts that demystify the buying process, and Google-focused website copy that funnels traffic straight to the auction feed. “Website, marketing and google” sum up the channels that matter most to me, but I’m open to repurposing pieces for social media when it makes sense.
Tech and creative preferences Feel free to choose the stack—WordPress + custom plugins, Laravel, MERN, or any other proven route—as long as it supports real-time data pulls and secure payments. For the marketing side, native video editing tools, Canva, or Adobe Premiere are fine; accuracy and quick turnaround beat fancy effects.
Acceptance criteria 1. Responsive website deployed on my hosting, subscription checkout tested and working. 2. Auction feed updates automatically; at least two live test bids placed in a staging environment. 3. First month’s marketing package delivered: three short videos, three promotional posts, and homepage copy optimized for Google. 4. Clear hand-off documentation so my team can add cars and schedule content without developer help.

item.title: Web Developer Needed: News and Magazine Website
item.description:

We cover three core sections: Politics, Economy, and Culture. We want a polished, professional publication in the style of The Atlantic, with a membership model similar to Public Notice.
Scope of Work - Set up and configure the site on a suitable platform. We are open to Ghost, WordPress, or another CMS you recommend, with a short explanation of why. Performance, security, and ease of future expansion are priorities. - Design a responsive, mobile-first layout with clear navigation between Politics, Economy, and Culture and a consistent look across the site. - Build a homepage with featured stories, section blocks, and a latest-news feed. - Set up a comment section under each article, with moderation tools. - Set up tiered memberships (free and paid) with Stripe or an equivalent payment provider, including paywalled or members-only content. - Add newsletter sign-up connected to the platform's built-in email tool or an email marketing service (e.g. Mailchimp), with CASL-compliant consent. - Configure SEO basics: Google Search Console, sitemap, Google News compatibility, social sharing previews, and analytics. - Set up an editor workflow with author and editor roles, drafts, scheduling, and publishing without touching code. - Apply our branding (we supply logo, colours, fonts, and initial copy).
Deliverables - Fully functional, tested website on our domain - Admin and editor accounts set up for our team - Written documentation covering publishing, memberships, newsletters, and comment moderation - Transfer of all theme, plugin, and service licenses and accounts to our ownership - A walk-through call (about 1 hour) with our editors - 30 days of post-launch bug-fix support
Requirements - Proven experience building news, magazine, or membership websites. Please include links to at least 2 live examples. - Experience with payment integration and email marketing integrations - Strong understanding of web performance, security, and accessibility - Clear communication and reliable timelines
To Apply, Please Include 1. Links to live news/magazine sites you have built 2. The platform you recommend for this project and why 3. Your estimated timeline and fixed-price quote 4. Expected monthly running costs (hosting, plugins, services) 5. Whether you offer ongoing maintenance after launch, and at what rate

item.title: Build the "HospoHelper" Website
item.description:
10-4000 AUD | WEB DEVELOPER WANTED — HOSPOHELPER
I’m looking for a web developer interested in helping me turn an idea I’ve been working on into a functioning website.
The idea: HospoHelper
HospoHelper is a free website aimed at helping young and casual hospitality workers in Australia understand what they should actually be getting paid — and what they can do if something doesn’t look right.
The idea comes from a pretty significant problem: underpayment remains widespread in Australia’s hospitality sector.
The Fair Work Ombudsman identifies fast food, restaurants and cafés as a priority sector because of persistent and significant non-compliance. In 2024–25 alone, the regulator recovered $3.1 million for 1,814 underpaid workers in the sector.¹
And individual compliance operations have found striking rates of non-compliance. Recent Fair Work investigations found:
* 93% of investigated food businesses in a Perth operation had breached workplace laws, with more than $769,000 recovered for 379 workers.² * 81% of businesses investigated during a south-east Melbourne operation had breached workplace laws.³ * In 2023–24, $5.6 million was recovered for 3,056 underpaid workers in fast food, restaurants and cafés nationally.⁴
The problem is particularly relevant to younger workers. The Fair Work Ombudsman notes that the sector employs large numbers of young people, casual and part-time workers and visa holders, some of whom may be unaware of their workplace rights or reluctant to speak up when something seems wrong.¹
At the same time, actually figuring out what you’re entitled to isn’t necessarily straightforward.
Awards, classifications, casual loading, evening rates, weekend penalty rates, overtime, allowances and public holidays can all affect what someone should receive.
For a university student working a few shifts at a pub, café or restaurant, answering one basic question can therefore become surprisingly complicated:
“I worked these hours this week. How much should I have been paid?”
That’s the question I want HospoHelper to make much easier to answer.
How it would work
The initial version of HospoHelper would centre around a simple, user-friendly wage calculator.
A worker could enter information such as:
* their age and employment type; * their role/classification; * the days and hours they worked; * breaks; * weekend/evening work; * whether a shift fell on a public holiday; and * what they were actually paid.
HospoHelper would then provide an estimated amount they should have received, explain how that estimate was calculated, and allow them to compare it against their actual pay.
For example:
Estimated pay: $842.60 Actual gross pay: $764.20 Potential difference: $78.40
But I don’t want the website to stop at identifying a possible discrepancy.
“I think I’ve been underpaid. What now?”
One feature I’d particularly like to explore is a guided underpayment pathway.
If HospoHelper identifies a potential discrepancy, the user could be taken through a simple step-by-step process explaining what they can do next.
This could include helping the user:
1. Double-check their pay Understand their classification, applicable rates and exactly how the estimate was calculated.
2. Check their payslip Know what information to look for and identify where a discrepancy might have occurred.
3. Raise it with their employer HospoHelper could generate a simple, non-confrontational message that the worker can send to their manager asking them to check their pay.
4. Keep the right records Explain the importance of retaining things like payslips, rosters, timesheets, employment documents and relevant messages.
5. Know where to go next If the issue isn’t resolved, provide straightforward information about external assistance and direct users towards official resources such as the Fair Work Ombudsman.
The aim isn’t for HospoHelper to replace professional or official advice or definitively determine that an employer has broken the law.
It’s about giving workers an accessible starting point to check their pay, understand it, and know what they can do if something doesn’t seem right.
Where it’s currently at
This is an early-stage concept.
I’ve purchased the domain and have the core idea, target audience and initial functionality in mind, but I’m looking for someone with the technical skills to help turn it into a working product.
I’m also very open to ideas about additional functionality and how HospoHelper could develop beyond the initial MVP.
Who I’m looking for
I’m looking for someone with web development experience who could help take HospoHelper from concept to a functioning MVP.
You don’t necessarily need years of professional experience. I’d be interested in speaking with university students, recent graduates, freelancers or experienced developers who like the idea and think they could build it.
Experience with responsive web development, databases/APIs, UI/UX, web calculators or similar projects would obviously be useful.
Most importantly, I’m looking for someone reliable who is interested in helping create something that could be genuinely useful for young Australian workers.
Payment/budget: Open to discussion depending on the proposed approach and scope.
If this sounds interesting, send me a message with a little about yourself, anything you’ve built previously, and how you think you’d approach the project.
Happy to share more details and chat through the idea privately.
⸻
Sources
1. Fair Work Ombudsman, Annual Report 2024–25. 2. Fair Work Ombudsman, More than $760,000 recovered for Perth workers, 27 June 2024. 3. Fair Work Ombudsman, $58,000 back-paid to Melbourne food staff, 1 August 2024. 4. Fair Work Ombudsman, Fast Food, Restaurants & Cafés compliance data, 2023–24.

item.title: Website Optimisation for Digital Art Sales
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I run an online store that offers downloadable abstract art prints. The site is live, theproducts are uploaded, yet the buying journey still feels unfinished and traffic remains modest. I need a hand turning the current setup into a polished, sales-ready experience.
First, every print must be fully commerce-enabled. That means con firming product variants, pricing tiers and automatic delivery links, then wiring each item to a reliable checkout and shipping solution so a customer can buy, download or request physical fulfilment without friction.
Next comes presentation. I want visitors to explore the collection through interactive galleries, zoom into crisp high-resolution images and even preview pieces inside virtual art rooms. You are free to propose the best-fit plugins or custom code, but the end result should feel immersive and load quickly on desktop and mobile alike.
Purchasing should be flexible. Customers must be able to complete the order directly on my site while simultaneously giving me the option to list the same SKUs on an external marketplace. A single source of truth for inventory and order tracking is important, so any integration you implement (API, feed, or middleware) needs to keep everything in sync.
Visibility is the last piece. My goal is higher rankings and more qualified traffic, so the focus is on keyword optimisation and fresh, engaging content around each artwork and artistic theme. Well-structured meta tags, schema, alt text and a concise content plan will be key; backlink outreach is not required right now.
Deliverables • Fully configured product catalogue with seamless checkout and shipping • Interactive gallery, high-resolution zoom and virtual room preview deployed site-wide • Dual sales channel integration (website + chosen marketplace) with synced stock/status • On-page SEO overhaul: keyword mapping, titles, meta, alt text, schema plus a short content calendar • Brief hand-off guide so I can maintain listings and publish new prints in the same workflow
If you have recent experience in e-commerce UX, art-focused presentation tools and practical SEO, I’d love to see how you would approach this upgrade.

item.description:

item.title: Freelance Pilates Instructor – Programme Creation (Remote, Task-Based)
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | Overview: I’m looking for a freelance instructor to create structured, progressive Pilates programmes for clients enrolled in a long-term coaching package. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the written and planning side of Pilates without any live teaching or client calls.
Responsibilities: • Create a full progressive Pilates plan based on client needs • Adapt the plan if required after reviewing client intake information • Deliver clear, accessible written instructions • Work independently and meet agreed deadlines
Requirements: • Pilates certification or relevant experience • Strong understanding of progression, alignment, and accessibility • Able to write clear, structured exercise plans • Reliable and organised
• Freelance/contract basis—no employment obligations
Ideal For: • Pilates instructors who enjoy programme design • Freelancers wanting flexible, task-based work • People who prefer written work over live teaching
How to Apply Please send your CV and a short message outlining your experience with Pilates programme design. You may include sample plans if you have them (optional).

item.title: Instagram & Website Management for Travel
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | I run a growing travel agency and I’m ready to hand over day-to-day control of both my Instagram presence and the website so they can finally work together as a single conversion engine.
Instagram comes first. I need steady growth in followers and overall brand awareness, so every post, reel, story, or live session has to feel inspiring, on-brand, share-worthy, and focused on building a strong brand identity. You’ll plan a content calendar, write captions, select hashtags, respond to comments, and track insights so we can see what moves the needle.i have a lot of content, and strong sense of aesthetic, so everything needs to be approved by me.
The site already exists; what’s missing is consistent upkeep: refreshing destination pages, adding newns.Making it more selling and convincing, we don’t need a booking system, just bring traffic.
Deliverables I’ll look for each month: • A scheduled, approved Instagram calendar covering posts, reels, stories, and planned lives • Analytics summary highlighting follower growth, reach, engagement rates, and traffic improvements • Updated website content plus a quick audit of the booking journey with fixes implemented or flagged
If you live and breathe travel content with a strong focus on aesthetics and growth strategies for brand identity development; know Meta Business Suite/Creator Studio; and can tweak WordPress (or similar CMS) without breaking the reservation plug-in—let’s talk about timelines and an initial content sprint to see how we work together.

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
